# Embassy v1.8.1 — the dashboard catches up with the rebuild

v1.8.0's release drill caught its own defect within minutes: real-boot status snapshots emitted deadline-pressure buckets in a shape the strict shared schema rejects, so every client — including Embassy's own — refused the response with `CONTROL_INVALID_RESPONSE`. Delivery was never affected (the drill proved live mail flowing while the dashboard was blind), but visibility is a promise too. Fixed, with a real-boot-shaped snapshot now rendered through the strict decoder in the test suite — the same live-shaped-fixture lesson this project keeps re-learning, now applied to its newest surface.

One honest note for upgraders from converted state: if a pre-v1.8 Claude selection fails deliveries with `CLAUDE_ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE`, run `select-claude` once; whether that reselection should ever be needed is under investigation.

Upgrade: `npm install -g agent-embassy@1.8.1`, restart your broker.
